name: automateintelligence
description: Conductor, spec-craft, bubo, and Marshal: spec-driven autonomous completion, a passive code review companion, and a manager for your other Claude Code sessions. Conductor, spec-craft and bubo install from Claude Code and OpenAI Codex. Marshal is Claude Code only (OpenAI Codex: not supported yet).

plugins.name: conductor
plugins.description: Autonomous spec-completion loop: spec -> plans -> phases -> machine-checked done. Runs on Claude Code and OpenAI Codex.

plugins.name: spec-craft
plugins.description: Make a spec's definition of done explicit and machine-checkable.

plugins.name: bubo
plugins.description: Passive code review companion: one clipped, in-character note when something is likely to break — inert until explicitly promoted.

plugins.name: marshal
plugins.description: Marshal: a manager session for your other Claude Code sessions. The plugin puts shared worker rules and the grilling and handoff skills in every session, and /marshal:init creates your private Marshal workspace. Claude Code only. OpenAI Codex: not supported yet.
